Name: Ali's Flower Grass - Content Patcher Edition
Author: minervamaga
TagLine: A conversion of Ali's Flower Grass for Content Patcher
Description:
DO NOT DOWNLOAD THIS MOD FROM ANYWHERE EXCEPT HERE, MODDROP, OR MY GITHUB
Other websites are stealing mods from Nexus and uploading them without permission, while earning money on each mod they steal.  My mods are always found on the three sites listed above and no where else.

Now in a standalone version, here's Ali's Flower Grass!  Spruce up your grass with some wildflowers, for that extra bit of aesthetic.

This mod requires [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915) to work.

WORKS WITH STARDEW VALLEY 1.4

Install

1.  [Install the latest version of SMAPI](https://smapi.io/).

2.  [Install Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915).

3.  Download this mod and unzip it, then copy  the '[CP] Ali's Flower Grass' folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.

4.  Run the game once using SMAPI to generate the config file.

5.  Access the config file from the mod folder and choose your settings.  Options will be listed below, as well as in the readme.
Config Options

*   WhichVersion - allows you to choose which variety of grass you like.  Variants as follows (defaults to Eemie):

1.  "Eemie"

2.  "Normal"

3.  "Alternate"

4.  "Vibrant"

5.  "AlternateVibrant"
Change Log

*   Version 1.0.2 - Adjusted folder nesting for easier installation

*   Version 1.0.1 - Fixed "None" option not working

*   Version 1.0.0 - Initial version
Credit for the original [flower grass](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/816)﻿ goes to [strawberrymilk95](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34430155), with many thanks for allowing me to do this conversion!
